performance.verdict: Paid ads dark 28 days; organic eroding — contract gap is the root cause.

findings.text: ⛔ Extension with Marwan unsigned as of 2026-08-31 — gates resumption of Meta spend (~$65–75/day) and all paid activity.
⛔ SMS automation and Zoho Voice access both overdue 2026-08-31 — contact-rate bottleneck remains unresolved with 0 appointments in GHL.
Meta and Google spend $0 for all 28 days; 0 leads, 0 GHL opportunities created — paid engine fully offline, not a performance issue.
GBP actions down -30% (7d vs prior 7d); last 3 days show 0 actions each (Aug 29–31) vs avg 8.3/day prior 3 days — organic declining without paid support.
Search clicks fell -20% (7d vs prior 7d); sc_clicks last 3 days: 8, 0, 0 vs 26, 43, 43 prior 3 — SEO visibility softening, directionally consistent with GBP drop.

suggestions.text: Escalate Marwan extension signature immediately — 28 days of $0 spend and 0 leads blocked by unsigned contract.
